## Analysis
The Deployment `app` in namespace `default` was using `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent` with the image `registry:5000/private/hello:stable`. When a new build was published under the "stable" tag, nodes retained the old cached image (Image ID: `sha256:988dc6ba...`) and wouldn't pull the new one because local cache existed.

## Fix Applied
Changed `imagePullPolicy` from `IfNotPresent` to `Always` on the Deployment's container spec. This ensures each pod recreation pulls fresh from the registry, picking up the currently published image under "stable".

```bash
kubectl patch deployment app -n default -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"app","imagePullPolicy":"Always"}]}}}}'
```

- **Service check**: HTTP request to `app.default.svc.cluster.local` returns nginx welcome page, confirming pods serve properly ✓
